C0336.title: Anti-Telecom Fraud Law Explicitly Bans Illegal Trading, Renting, and Lending of IoT SIMs
C0336.summary: The Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law, passed on September 2, 2022, explicitly prohibits any entity or individual from illegally trading, renting, or lending phone cards and IoT cards, or opening phone cards, IoT cards, financial accounts, or internet accounts under false identities or fabricated agency relationships. It also requires telecom operators to enforce real-name registration and risk-monitoring duties.
